review_comments_data.body: Thanks Lilit, but can you explain in what way this improves server security?

Enhancements to server performance have been implemented and documented in the yarl.lock file. These improvements aim to optimize the server's functionality and overall efficiency, ensuring a smoother and more responsive experience. Please refer to the yarl.lock file for detailed insights into the applied enhancements.
Enhancing server performance through updates in the yarl.lock file can be achieved by employing the yarn upgrade <package name> command.
But this change is just correcting the alphabetic order of the entries, surely.

issues.title: Investigate security-related updates
issues.body:
I've had a warning about upstream dependencies in Serge build:

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/1108513/96308a9d-634f-4e7d-82a7-2cc72d1f38b6)

Could you investigate to see if we can update any of these for our repo?  If they are actually pulled in by upstream dependencies that we have no control over, then that's ok - we'll leave those.
